apk.notes: The Android app is now signed with Elite 4 Collectibles' own key. Android phones reinstall once (the app shows how, about 2 minutes); your shop's data stays in the cloud.

web.notes: The Android app is now signed with Elite 4 Collectibles' own key. Android phones reinstall once (the app shows how, about 2 minutes); your shop's data stays in the cloud.

ios.notes: Privacy Policy link on the sign-in screen and in Settings.

desktop.notes: Faster and lighter on the cloud: each phone and computer now downloads only what changed since it was last open, instead of the whole shop every time. New: Refresh Everything (desktop: Settings → Phones & Cloud; phone: Settings → Shop) downloads it all again if anything ever looks out of date.
